### Christ’s Tender Love for the Wounded
Author: Jennifer Slattery
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/christs-tender-love-for-the-wounded-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Mark 7:31-36
Points:
- Jesus demonstrated deep personal compassion by leading the deaf and mute man away from the crowd.
- Taking him aside preserved the man's dignity rather than turning his condition into a public spectacle.
- Silencing the witnesses showed Jesus was driven by genuine love rather than the pursuit of acclaim.
- Christ treats every hurting individual with tender care rather than as a means to an end.

### Being Led by the Holy Spirit
Author: Rick Renner
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/sparkling-gems/
Passage: Matthew 9:27-30
Points:
- Believers often act on their own initiatives and then ask God to bless the results.
- The two blind men displayed persistent faith by following and crying out to Jesus without giving up.
- Jesus ministered in complete dependence on the guidance and timing of the Holy Spirit.
- Lasting spiritual fruit comes when believers learn to wait and listen for the Spirit's direction.
